title.narrative: Enhancing legitimate stability and human security in Africa: continental,regional and national approaches

description.narrative:
Outcome 1: Enhanced decision-making knowledge and capacity at the continental (AU), regional (RECs) and national (Ethiopia) levels.
Outocme 2: Informed political and thematic dialogue on African peace, security and governance issues.
Outcome 3: Inclusive, transparent and effective governance at the continental, regional and national levels.
The project aims at supporting continental, regional and national efforts to promote peace, stability and good governance in Africa.

actual.value: ISS in partnership with the University of bahir dar and UNESCO delivered two consequetive trqinings on 'National Dialogue and Ethical reporting' for senior medial personalities in Addis Ababa. The first round of the training took place in Addis Ababa on 30 march 2024 for medial personalities largely operating in Addis based media outlets. The second round of the training brought trainees from Amhara region state and non state medial houses. the training was delivered on 24 September 2024 in Addis Ababa.

comment.narrative: At least two open seminars organized on key thematic issues

The ISS organized two open seminars: 1. On the theme : "Can the Ukraine Conflict build bridges between Africa and Europe" The objectiv was to take stock of the evolution and current dynamics of the Africa-EU partnerships as well as build bridges of understanding between Africa and Europe in the context of the ongoing Russia-Ukraine conflict. 2. On the theme: "Over coming electoral Challenges in Africa". The objective was to interrogate electoral processes and elections in Africa, evaluate the policies and strategies available at the continental and regional levels and provide targeted recommendations as to how best the AU and RECs can support countries to address electoral challenges in the short, medium and long term

The ISS provided technical support to the Navy Technical Committee. It held three meetings, two virtual meetings and one in-person meeting in collaboration with the Nigerian Navy and other stakeholders. The objective of the meetings was to develop the draft modalities for the operationalization of a combined maritime taskforce as well as the Concept of Operations (CONOPs)
